analysis:
Rajasthan's Integrated Clean Energy Policy 2024, which carries a foreword by Chief Minister Bhajan Lal Sharma, sets a target of 125,000 MW (125 GW) of renewable power capacity by 2029-30.

The policy's vision section frames this as Rajasthan's contribution to India's national 500 GW target. PIB reported Rajasthan at over 35.4 GW installed renewable capacity in July 2025. MNRE-based reporting put the state past 50,000 MW in August 2026.

The target date is 2029-30, so the commitment remains open and is recorded as in progress.
